N-4.1-A.skill: compare momentum and kinetic energy of two moving objects to predict stopping time and stopping distance

N-4.1-B.skill: find the velocity of the center of mass of a system with signed momenta, and recognize that an internal collision does not change it

N-4.2-A.skill: use the area under a force-time record with a sign change and the initial velocity to find a final velocity

N-4.2-B.skill: compare the average forces in two collisions by the change in momentum, including a rebound, rather than by speed lost or energy lost

N-4.3-A.skill: apply conservation of momentum to an internal explosion of a moving object, keeping signs and the initial momentum

N-4.3-B.skill: chain a perfectly inelastic collision with a moving target to an energy calculation, using momentum for the collision and energy only afterward

N-4.4-A.skill: classify a collision from momentum and kinetic energy before and after, using numbers

N-4.4-B.skill: compare an elastic collision with a perfectly inelastic one for the same incoming object, tracking momentum, kinetic energy and impulse
